KaTeX, LaTeX math rendering (used by the Markdown to PDF tool)
===============================================================

Package:  katex 0.18.9, unmodified:
            katex.min.js, katex.min.css   from dist/
            fonts/*.woff2                 from dist/fonts/ (only the WOFF2 files; every
                                          browser that runs this site picks WOFF2 first,
                                          so the WOFF and TTF copies the CSS also lists
                                          are never requested)
